body.title: Sanitize temporary errors before inspecting untrusted prototypes
body.reproduction: The provider-diagnostics fixture throws a proxy whose property/prototype traps throw a private canary. It expects unsupported-temporary but gets an unclassified error. The rpc-diagnostics fixture similarly reports CM_PRIVATE_RAW_GETTER from failedOutput rather than a safe temporary failure. Both are captured in the failure audit.
body.rootCause: withStructuredRetry checks instanceof VibeTurnError before its session-memory safe conversion, and failedOutput checks instanceof LookupFailedError before its temporary-mode branch. instanceof can invoke getPrototypeOf on an untrusted proxy, bypassing the intended safe error path.
body.fixIntent: Ensure temporary requests produce safe typed failures without touching untrusted error properties or prototypes, preserving saved-mode diagnostics, nonretryable refusals and authority checks. Acceptance: provider and RPC hostile-proxy fixtures pass, no private canary reaches logs/envelopes, and saved positive controls retain normal diagnostics. Scope excludes general test cleanup and reviewed-evidence regeneration.
